title: 第283章 入场第282章 美德骑士
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
荣耀帝国入城的动静，在学城里回荡了整整一个下午都没有彻底平息。
几乎所有人都在关注。
其中一处华贵的古堡里，四级魔法师古德里安也在看着。
他面上看不出什么表情来，但内心对荣耀皇帝的这种做派还是不满意的。
“这家伙太飘了，也太霸道了。
这对泰伦世界往后征战星海，可不见得是什么好事。”
“整不好就会把泰伦世界带进沟里去！”
“看来以后得限制一下荣耀帝国了。”
古德里安无疑是一位智者，他在心里已经给这位荣耀皇帝下了判定。
对方不可能会是带领泰伦走向辉煌的人。
荣耀帝国也最多只能做一名打手。
引领文明发展的重任，交给这群被魔兽血脉影响理智的家伙可不行。
而魔法帝国也不太行。
限于学习魔法需要的天赋、资源都太苛刻。
只能当作精英来培养。
注定了大部分人走不了这条路。
而相对之下，骑士的修炼就容易多了，也更方便普及。
泰伦世界七成的修炼者还是走的骑士之道。
“那难道会是星辰之心吗？”古德里安想到对方那传奇般的成长经历。
心里越琢磨越觉得靠谱。

星辰之心无疑是人们心目中的那种正义骑士。
对方把骑士荣耀、骑士美德化仿佛全部刻进了基因深处。
并且全部转化成行动，体现在一言一行里。
骑士联盟现在能发展到现在这个地步，并且还在不断强大。
星辰之心的人格魅力占据了很大一份功劳。
那些加入骑士联盟的家族，就是相信星辰之心的信誉。
不担心会被骗进来，榨干价值。
所以这千年来，骑士联盟的实力已经和荣耀帝国不相上下了。
至于魔法帝国，战力则是不太好估算。
没人知道这些老阴逼手里藏着点什么。
但就知道一点就行了。
这些魔法师越老越强！！
凡是入了阶的魔法师，手里都有几手绝活。
和一个魔法师对战，逼急了，指不定对方就拉着你玩个大的。
至于最后一个商业联邦。
不提也罢！
提供好后勤，打打顺风局就行了。
content_en:
The news of the Glory Empire's entry into the city echoed in the school city for a whole afternoon and did not completely subside.
Almost everyone is paying attention.
In one of the luxurious castles, the fourth-level magician Guderian was also watching.
There was no expression on his face, but in his heart he was still dissatisfied with Emperor Glory's behavior.
“This guy is too arrogant and domineering.
It is not necessarily a good thing for the Tyranid world to conquer the star sea in the future. "
"If it's not done right, it will lead the Tyranid world into a ditch!"
"It seems that the Glory Empire will have to be restricted in the future."
Guderian was undoubtedly a wise man, and he had already made a judgment on this glorious emperor in his heart.
The other party cannot be the person who leads Tyron to glory.
Glory Empire can only be a thug at most.
The important task of leading the development of civilization cannot be left to these guys whose sanity is affected by the blood of Warcraft.
And the Magic Empire is not very good either.
It is too demanding to be limited to the talents and resources required to learn magic.
They can only be cultivated as elites.
It is destined that most people will not be able to take this path.
In contrast, the training of knights is much easier and more convenient to popularize.
Seventy percent of the cultivators in the Tyran world still follow the path of knights.
"Could that be the Heart of the Stars?" Guderian thought of the other party's legendary growth experience.
The more I thought about it, the more reliable it seemed to me.
Star Heart is undoubtedly the kind of knight of justice that people think of.
The other party seems to have engraved the glory and virtue of knights deep into their genes.
And everything is transformed into actions, reflected in every word and deed.
The Knights Alliance has developed to this point and is still growing stronger.
Star Heart's charisma takes a large part of the credit.
Those families who join the Knights Alliance believe in the credibility of Star Heart.
Don't worry about being scammed and draining the value.
Therefore, over the past thousand years, the strength of the Knights Alliance has been comparable to that of the Glory Empire.
As for the Magic Empire, its combat power is difficult to estimate.
No one knows what these old bastards are hiding.
But just know a little bit.
These magicians get stronger as they get older! !
All magicians who have reached the level have several unique skills in their hands.
If you are fighting against a magician, if you are in a hurry, the other person might pull you into a big game.
As for the last commercial federation.
Just don’t mention it!
Just provide good logistics and have a favorable situation.
